name: Kurisu
source:
Noble and refined. A polite, earnest, model student type. Though from a good family, she treats everyone equally, earning the affection of the villagers.

She is reserved about sex. In matters of love, she is extremely pure-hearted and prone to daydreaming.

She is rescued by Kane while being attacked by monsters that raided the village. She offers her virginity in exchange for Kane's promise to defeat the monsters.

[From the [url=https://fandc.co.jp/dragonsraid/charactor01.html]Official website[/url]]
